# nixenvironment

**Tag**: tooling, devops

## 简介

Installs, updates and manages inner environment stuff to make build and deploy for NIX projects.

## 官网

- 主页: https://rubygems.org/gems/nixenvironment
- 文档: https://www.rubydoc.info/gems/nixenvironment/0.0.161
